remarks:
Spectacularly maintained 1998 ToT bungalow is freshly updated and ready for its next caretaker. This home has been lovingly maintained by the original owners and it's new chapter is setup to be a great one. The cozy covered front porch leads into the open plan dining/living room with soaring 20' ceilings and large windows to bring in tons of natural light. The backyard is perfect for summer parties on the deck by the pool, or hanging out with some pets in the private, fully fenced yard. 

Every inch of the home has been kept in pristine condition with updates inside and out as needed. HVAC system has been professionally serviced annually. The bathroom updates 3 years ago with a beautiful custom tile walk in shower and new everything. Above ground pool stays as does the Kohler Awning which has been professionally installed and removed seasonally. Kitchen TV and basement TV, speakers and stereo, and ice maker included as-is. 

Seller reserves the right to set an offer deadline but none at this time. Offers reviewed as received.
Showings begin Wednesday, 10/7/26 at 12PM.
